title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We are thrilled to launch Spyglass, our powerful new tool designed to bring you deeper insights and greater control over your information.

title: Master Your Media: New File Management Features
summary: We've empowered you with robust new tools to easily upload, manage, and customize how your images and documents appear within the editor.

title: Transparent Progress: Our New Public Roadmap
summary: We've launched a new roadmap page on our website, making it easier than ever to see what we've shipped, what's next, and what's planned for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a more intuitive experience with our redesigned checkboxes, now easier to click, drag, and seamlessly integrated into our updated user interface.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've significantly enhanced our editor's real-time collaboration features, providing a smoother, more intuitive experience with clearer insights into your team's work.

title: Seamless Discovery of Shared Content
summary: We've made it significantly easier to discover and utilize all content shared with you, fostering a more connected and productive collaborative experience.

title: Experience Noeko in Your Language
summary: Noeko now offers comprehensive support for multiple international languages, empowering users worldwide to experience our platform in their preferred language.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: Get ready for unparalleled control and transparency as we open-source Noeko, inviting you to actively shape its future alongside us.

title: Dynamic Constellation View
summary: Experience a more powerful and personalized knowledge graph as we introduce advanced filtering by tags, time, and shared items to supercharge your exploration and workflow.

title: Personalized Search & Knowledge Collections
summary: Uncover precisely what you need by applying advanced filters and sorting options, then save your refined searches as custom knowledge collections for effortless access.

title: Enhanced Content Links
summary: Empower your notes with dynamic, interactive previews of linked content, creating a seamless and personalized experience for organizing your thoughts.

title: Unlock Noeko's Full Potential: Self-Hosting and Premium Plans
summary: Experience the ultimate flexibility with Noeko's upcoming self-hosting option and unlock a suite of advanced features designed to supercharge your productivity.

title: Elevate Your Style: New Themes & Improvements
summary: Experience a refreshed look with our improved existing themes and an exciting collection of brand-new aesthetic options to personalize your workspace.

title: Always On-Time Greetings
summary: We're ensuring your homepage greeting always precisely matches the current time of day, enhancing your personalized experience with every visit.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Efficiently manage your content by performing bulk actions, including unapplying tags, directly from the tag overview, saving you time and clicks.

title: Unlock More Content Types
summary: Capture insights from a wider variety of sources like YouTube videos, websites, and text files, empowering you to consolidate all your valuable information in one place.
